name: sigarda's splendor
mana cost: {2}{W}{W}
types: enchantment
replacement: as CARDNAME enters, note your life total.
triggered: at the beginning of your upkeep, draw a card if your life total is greater than or equal to the last noted life total for CARDNAME. then note your life total. as CARDNAME enters, note your life total.
triggered: whenever you cast a white spell, you gain 1 life.
